parse.title: Dark Mage
parse.text:
Meta Unit
This unit is one of the most effective units in the game!
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 20.4.1 Fool's Hunt!

Overview

Dark Mage is a Secret Limited unit. He can only be obtained via completing The Fallen Star Portal (guaranteed if you are the host).

Evolving

Dark Mage can evolve into Dark Mage (Fallen Star) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Dark Mage
x1 Black Spear
x12 Star Fruit
x3 Star Fruit (Blue)
x5 Star Fruit (Red)
x4 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Dark Mage (Fallen Star)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
